diet: Attention, one more episode at a time
bio: A small bat that only ever watches the first episode. It hangs upside down in caves and squeaks a theme tune at anything that walks past.
A red bat that asks "still watching?" every third turn and starts the next one before you answer. It sleeps all day and nobody has seen it blink at night.
note: Mailed discs once. Nobody believes it.
Starts the next one before you can stop it.
